description: Reference packet for conditional axis-centre descent arithmetic. The hash-pinned matter table determines the common diagonal Z6 kernel and maximal effective quotient of that representation. Local tensors descend through quotients by 1, Z2, Z3, and Z6, so they do not select a physical global form. The global-form artifact measures the carrier deck action and six antipodal axes, then computes an order-six class group and sector menu from declared diagonal and zero-sum axis relations. Transport, lattice, polarization, and refinement checks are exact inside that declared coefficient system. Source selection of the relation lattice, character-category completeness, a same-source loop-to-kernel identity, and physical line attachment are open.
